description: This file contains functions for exporting various Mattermost data structures (teams, channels, users, posts, reactions, roles, schemes, thread followers) into a common import format, likely for data migration or backup purposes.

methods.name: importLineFromTeam
methods.description: Converts a TeamForExport object into an import LineData format for teams.

methods.name: importLineFromChannel
methods.description: Converts a ChannelForExport object into an import LineData format for channels.

methods.name: importLineFromDirectChannel
methods.description: Converts a DirectChannelForExport object into an import LineData format for direct channels, including participants and optional favorited/shown by info.

methods.name: importDirectChannelMembersFromChannelMembers
methods.description: Transforms channel members into import format, including notification preferences.

methods.name: importLineFromUser
methods.description: Converts a User object into an import LineData format, including preferences.

methods.name: importLineFromBot
methods.description: Converts a Bot object into an import LineData format.

methods.name: importUserTeamDataFromTeamMember
methods.description: Creates user-team role associations for import from team member data.

methods.name: importUserChannelDataFromChannelMemberAndPreferences
methods.description: Creates user-channel role and notification data for import.

methods.name: importLineForPost
methods.description: Converts a PostForExport object into an import LineData for posts.

methods.name: importLineForDirectPost
methods.description: Converts a DirectPostForExport object into an import LineData for direct posts.

methods.name: importReplyFromPost
methods.description: Converts a ReplyForExport object into an import ReplyData.

methods.name: importReactionFromPost
methods.description: Creates a ReactionImportData from user and reaction info.

methods.name: importLineFromEmoji
methods.description: Converts an Emoji object into an import LineData for emojis.

methods.name: importRoleDataFromRole
methods.description: Converts a Role object into an import RoleData.

methods.name: importLineFromRole
methods.description: Wraps role data into an import LineData for roles.

methods.name: importLineFromScheme
methods.description: Converts a Scheme object into an import LineData, including default roles based on scope.

methods.name: importFollowerFromThreadMember
methods.description: Creates thread follower import data from thread membership info.

search-terms: team, channel, user, post, reaction, role, scheme, thread
